title: Tuning the Magnetic Interactions in Dy(III) Single-Molecule Magnets

material_class.structural_family: Nearly coplanar Dy4 parallelogram with a distorted defective-dicubane Dy4O8 core

synthesis.procedure: Prepared from Dy(NO3)3·6H2O, H2L and NEt3 by a previously reported solvent-evaporation procedure. The main article gives no reagent quantities. Crystals had begun to form after 24 h.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystallization by solvent evaporation; further details are not given in the main article.

properties.summary: A single-molecule magnet showing slow magnetization relaxation and antiferromagnetic intramolecular interactions. No hysteresis was detected at 1.8 K; its spin-reversal blocking temperature was inferred to be below 2 K.

source_locations.location: Experimental section, Syntheses of the Complexes, synthesis of 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Four nearly coplanar Dy(III) ions form a parallelogram-shaped, distorted defective-dicubane Dy4O8 core. Two symmetry-related Dy2(L)2 units are linked through μ3-hydroxide bridges; Dy1 is nine-coordinate and Dy2 is eight-coordinate.

synthesis.procedure: The preparation of 1 was repeated with trifluoroacetylactone (Htfaa) added to the reaction solution as a replacement axial-ligand precursor. No reagent quantity is given in the main article.

reagents.name: dysprosium(III) nitrate hexahydrate
reagents.role: metal source in the shared preparation

reagents.name: triethylamine
reagents.amount: 0.4 mmol, 0.06 mL initially; 0.2 mmol, 0.03 mL with Htfaa

synthesis.time: Stirred for 10 min before adding the Dy salt, then 30 min; stirred for 1 h after addition of the DMF solution; filtrate stood for two days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Modification of the solvent-evaporation preparation of 1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered; the filtrate stood at room temperature, and yellow block-shaped crystals formed by slow solvent evaporation over two days and were collected by careful filtration.

properties.summary: A single-molecule magnet with antiferromagnetic intramolecular interactions and two relaxation regimes. No hysteresis was detected at 1.8 K.

measurements.name: Effective relaxation barrier Ueff/kB
measurements.conditions: Fit of slow-relaxation data to Raman and Orbach processes

source_locations.location: Experimental section, Syntheses of the Complexes, synthesis of 2

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Related to the Dy4 core of 1, but tfaa occupies the changeable axial sites at Dy1/Dy1a in place of the axial ligands of 1. These two Dy sites become eight-coordinate, while the Dy2/Dy2a coordination spheres remain substantially unchanged.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared in the same way as 2, substituting acetylacetonate precursor Hacac for Htfaa as the modified axial ligand. No reagent quantity is given in the main article.

reagents.name: dysprosium(III) nitrate hexahydrate
reagents.role: metal source in the shared preparation

reagents.name: triethylamine
reagents.role: base in the procedure for 2; added in two portions
reagents.amount: 0.4 mmol, 0.06 mL initially; 0.2 mmol, 0.03 mL with the axial-ligand precursor

synthesis.temperature: Room temperature during crystallization, following the procedure for 2
synthesis.time: Slow solvent evaporation for two days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow block-shaped crystals formed by slow solvent evaporation over two days and were collected by careful filtration.

properties.summary: A single-molecule magnet with ferromagnetic intramolecular interactions and two relaxation regimes. Replacing tfaa in 2 with acac increases the fitted effective relaxation barrier. No hysteresis was detected at 1.8 K.

measurements.name: Effective relaxation barrier Ueff/kB
measurements.conditions: Fit of slow-relaxation data to Raman and Orbach processes

source_locations.location: Experimental section, Syntheses of the Complexes, synthesis of 3 (similar process to 2)

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Retains a Dy4O8 core closely related to that of 2. Acac replaces tfaa at the axial Dy1/Dy1a sites, which remain eight-coordinate; the Dy2/Dy2a coordination spheres and overall core change only slightly.
